items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Holt was on the trombone, I was on the trumpet

ctx.x: The boy's cousin on drums, I picked up a clarinet band, Holt was on the trombone, I was on the trumpet -- not too many. Just that piano -- no, no piano -- drums, trumpet, trombone and clarinet. We played such things as 'Storm and Sunshine' and 'Chicago Tribune March', you know. We had those. Re-de-le- -- you know, you know how they go.
